description: Enable auto-layout on a frame and configure direction, spacing, padding, and alignment. Set direction to NONE to disable auto-layout.

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Sizing along cross axis — FIXED holds the frame size, AUTO hugs children (default AUTO)

padding.description: Padding — single number (all sides) or {top, right, bottom, left}

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Sizing along main axis — FIXED holds the frame size, AUTO hugs children (default AUTO)

name: set_auto_layout
